decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 20th May 2003, the erection of a detached shed in the rear of the site and the ground floor extension (2.8m x 5.44m x 3.66m less the two existing kitchen projections of 1.9m x 0.9m x 1.6m) is lawful within the meaning of section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reasons:

The detached shed will be located over 5 metres from the existing dwellinghouse and does not exceed 50% of the total area of the curtilage and falls within Schedule 2, Part 1, Class E of the Town and County Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 and the volume of the proposed single storey rear extension is less than 50m3 and falls within Schedule 2, Part 1, Class A of the Town and County Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the erection of a single storey rear extension and detached single storey garden shed to rear of dwellinghouse.
